result.title: ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights
result.summary: We introduce ShamAN-Q, a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that extends NanoQuant by replacing each its diagonal reconstruction geometry with a tractable dense curvature metric, using a general paradigm popularized by the Shampoo optimizer. For each linear weight, ShamAN-Q fits a Kronecker product to the empirical Fisher information matrix of a small calibration set by Kullback--Leibler minimization, forming a Mahalanobis reconstruction loss from the result. The continuous ADMM updates from NanoQuant become solutions to Sylvester equations, while its discrete projection and deployment format remain unchanged. Because the curvature is local to a given set of weights, ShamAN-Q re-measures the input curvature statistic for each layer immediately before layer factorization, periodically refreshing all statistics on the partially quantized model. ShamAN-Q also redistributes the uniform rank from NanoQuant across layers at the same total number of bits. On Qwen3-Base, ShamAN-Q lowers WikiText-2 perplexity at $\approx$1 bpw from 27.56 to 22.96 (0.6B), 19.21 to 16.72 (1.7B), and 14.29 to 13.80 (4B) while matching or improving zero-shot accuracy on the Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness. On 0.6B, ShamAN-Q at $\approx$0.8 bpw matches the published perplexity of NanoQuant at $\approx$1.0 bpw.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ShamAN-Q，一种 sub-1-bit LLM 后训练量化方法：用 Shampoo 式的 Kronecker 因子化密集曲率度量替代 NanoQuant 的对角重建几何，通过 KL 最小化拟合经验 Fisher，并将连续 ADMM 更新化为 Sylvester 方程求解，在 Qwen3-Base 上降低低比特困惑度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作只针对纯文本 LLM 的极低比特权重量化与重建误差优化，未涉及视觉或多模态推理的状态、证据使用或停止决策，材料中也无 latent 推理状态或视觉旁路线索，故不纳入。
